description: Rank the cheapest models for a task tier. Filters by optional vision and price ceiling. Returns top_n models sorted by input price ascending. Use when the user asks 'what's the cheapest way to X'.

max_input_price_per_million_usd.description: Filter out models whose input price exceeds this.

task_type.description: Which tier of model to consider. 'any' scans all.

vision.description: If true, only return models with vision support.

name: cheapest_for
